sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Disable analytics
Stops usage statistics and affiliate link reports.
Disable update prompts
Removes automatic update dialogs. The Version row in Settings still checks manually.
Enable image saving
Shows a save button on full-screen product and review photos.
Fix dark mode
Fixes the screens and web pages the built-in Dark mode leaves white. Requires Android 10 or later.
GmsCore support
Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Remove promotional popups
Stops coupon offers opening over Home and search results.
Remove sponsored items
Removes paid placements from search results and product feeds.
Skip splash promotions
Skips the full-screen promotion shown at launch.
Spoof signature
Restores product loading on patched installs.

sources.label: AliExpress
sources.author: AliExpress
patch_list: Bypass signature check
Bypasses SecurityGuard integrity checks to restore login on patched APKs.
Disable analytics
Blocks analytics and tracking sent to AliExpress servers.
Disable forced updates
Disables the forced update popup that prevents using older versions of the app.
Disable promotions notifications
Disables promotional push notifications for deals and coupons.
Disable splash screen
Skips the splash screen on app launch.
Enable image saving
Enables saving product images directly to the device gallery.
Remove ads
Removes sponsored products and advertisements from the AliExpress home feed and search results.
Remove affiliate tracking
Removes affiliate tracking parameters from shared links.
Remove coupons popup
Removes the coupon and promotion popup dialogs.
Remove sponsored items from search
Filters out sponsored and promoted products from search results.
